career_path_block.路径: Agricultural machinery or water resources engineers

career_path_block.说明: Stable work with long result cycles

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for agricultural engineers is not AI but a small job market. AI improves calculations, but the total number of roles is limited. Choosing the right employer and specialization matters more than working hard without direction.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is industry fragmentation and income disparity. Jobs concentrate in generally small machinery and water-resources organizations. Field conditions are demanding, compensation trails comparable industrial engineering roles, and fewer young people choose the field.
risks: Industry fragmentation: small and geographically dispersed job market
Income gap: below the industrial engineering average
Demanding conditions: extensive fieldwork
Narrow employment base: transitions require rebuilding experience
Policy dependence: projects follow support programs

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate optimal irrigation volumes and plan machinery routes, but agricultural engineers must visit the field to determine whether a plan can be implemented there and whether farmers will use it.

career_path_block.说明: 被软件与 AI 替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 农业工程师最大的风险不是 AI，而是「行业盘子小」——AI 帮你算得更好，但岗位总量有限，选对平台和方向比埋头干活更重要。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「行业分散与收入落差」——农业工程岗位集中在农机和水利行业，规模普遍不大；田间工作条件艰苦，收入低于同级别工业工程师，年轻人入行意愿低。
risks: 行业分散：岗位规模小、地域分散
收入落差：低于工业工程师均值
条件艰苦：田间作业多
就业面窄：转型要重新积累
政策依赖：项目跟着扶持政策走

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算出最优灌溉量、能规划农机路线，但「这套方案在这片地上能不能落地、农户愿不愿意用」——这个答案，得农业工程师下地找。

career_path_block.说明: Requires both technical and market expertise
Requires knowledge of data and compliance
career_path_block.路径: Technical management at a breeding facility

career_path_block.说明: Squeezed by both compliance requirements and AI

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but the long return cycle. Developing a strong line can take three to five years, and every step has to go right.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this occupation is not AI but heavy responsibility and slow returns. Retiring one breeding animal can erase a full year's breeding plan, while market swings directly affect income.
risks: Income varies widely, and unsold young animals directly reduce earnings when the market weakens
Breeding season is intense, with consecutive overnight shifts and fragmented sleep
The responsibility is heavy, and retiring breeding animals or losing young animals can take a psychological toll
Animal disease can harm the entire population when prevention measures fail
Compliance standards are tightening, leaving less room for unlicensed informal breeders

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how advanced genetic technology becomes, people will remain responsible for delivery, neonatal care, and observation. The human touch that machines cannot replace is also why this occupation endures.

responsibilities: Develop and carry out breeding plans
Manage care during pregnancy and assist with delivery
Raise young animals and improve survival rates
Maintain pedigree and health records for the population
skills: Knowledge of animal breeding and genetics

被合规与 AI 双重挤压

career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「责任重、回报慢」——一只种畜的淘汰可能意味着一整年的育种规划作废，而市场行情波动直接决定收入。

行业合规趋严，无资质散户空间被压缩

responsibilities: 负责孕产期照护与接生
培育幼崽并提高成活率
维护种群谱系与健康档案
skills: 动物繁育与遗传学知识

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but central kitchens and automation. Production lines absorb standardized bread, while people with product-development skills become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but mass-production automation and chain central kitchens. Industrial production lines absorb standardized bread, while independent bakers retain customers through craftsmanship and flavor.

Automated production lines
Chains drive down prices
Ingredient price volatility
Occupational health risks from flour dust and prolonged standing

career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「量产自动化 + 连锁中央厨房」——工厂化产线吃掉标准面包，独立烘焙师靠手艺和风味留人。

career_path_block.说明: Exposed to EDC and AI replacement
Experience and relationships form the moat

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest CRC risk is system replacement of data-only work. Participant management and Site operations still depend on people, making relationship and project skills increasingly important.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk combines AI adoption in standardized workflows with heavy workload. Remaining roles concentrate around participant management and Site operations.

Heavy workload: dense follow-up schedules and frequent overtime
High turnover: detailed work combines with pressure
Serious compliance responsibility: errors in data and processes carry consequences
Participant uncertainty: withdrawals affect project schedules

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can clean data and organize documents, but CRCs still need to understand why participants withdraw and how to retain them. responsibilities: 受试者招募与随访管理
skills: 受试者招募与随访管理

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is project-based work, which can leave workers without income between productions. People who alter garments, understand fabrics, and rescue performances remain useful on projects of any size. Stockroom-only attendants face the earliest cuts.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are its small size and strong seasonality. Many costume jobs follow projects, theaters have performance seasons, and productions have schedules. No production means no work. Digital inventory systems also replace stockroom-only roles.
risks: Small occupation: limited theater and production positions
Project volatility: no production means no work

Physical strain: moving garment racks and standing during changes

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can create costume lists instantly and scans can locate each garment. When an actor's waistband splits three minutes before the show, human hands still have to sew it. Emergency craft is the real livelihood of Costume Attendants. This is career-exploration guidance, not a hiring or employment forecast.

responsibilities: Inventory and store costumes and accessories
Assist performers with dressing and changes
Maintain records and circulate costumes by performance

career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「岗位总量小与季节性强」——服装岗多随项目走，剧院有演出季、剧组有档期，不接戏就没活；纯保管型岗位还会被数字化台账替代。

项目波动：不接戏就没活

responsibilities: 登记台账并按场次流转

career_path_block.说明: Dual responsibility for technical work and safety

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks for logging-equipment operators are machinery accidents and mountain environments, not AI. Safety discipline protects your life.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risks are the physical hazards of machinery and mountains, not AI. Difficult outdoor rescue: remote forests slow emergency response
Seasonal volatility: large income differences between peak and slow harvesting periods
Occupational illness: vibration, noise, and prolonged outdoor work cause harm

page.contract_project_risk_block: Even the most intelligent harvester needs someone to decide which tree falls first and which slope is impassable. Machines in the mountains always need a reliable operator at the controls.

responsibilities: Operate equipment for felling and skidding
Follow harvest-area plans and record production
Perform pre-shift inspection and equipment maintenance
Identify risks and follow safety procedures

career_risk_cards.callout: 林业设备操作员最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「机械事故与山区环境」——安全纪律就是你的保命符。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「机械与山地的物理风险」——倒木失控、陡坡侧翻、设备故障都可能造成严重事故，加上林区偏远，救援困难，安全纪律是这行的生命线。

野外救援困难：林区偏远，突发情况响应慢
季节波动：采伐旺季淡季收入差距大

政策影响：采伐限制与环保要求波动需求

page.contract_project_risk_block: 再智能的采伐机，也要有人判断哪棵树先倒、哪段坡不能过——山里的机器，永远得有个靠谱的人掌舵。

按伐区规划执行并记录产量

responsibilities: 开发并跟进企业客户线索
输出方案并主导商务谈判
推动签约、回款与交付协调
维护老客户并挖掘增购机会
skills: 销售漏斗与 CRM 管理

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but emotional depletion. Without supervision and support systems, even committed teachers leave. A professional support network is essential for longevity.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but physical and emotional exhaustion. One-on-one interventions are intensive, progress is slow, and parental pressure is substantial. Sustained high emotional labor produces significant turnover.
risks: High-intensity emotional labor and physical and psychological exhaustion
Slow progress creates frustration and self-doubt
Parental anxiety and expectation pressure
Income does not fully match effort
Complex cases combine responsibility with professional risk

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can generate a compliant plan in one minute, but a child screaming in a corner needs a person to kneel down and help them calm first. Machines cannot replace that companionship, which is why this occupation exists.

responsibilities: Assess child development and develop IEPs
Implement behavioral intervention and coordinate rehabilitation

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「被情绪耗干」——没有督导和支持系统，再热爱的老师也会被磨走；建立专业支持网络，才能干得久。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「身心透支」——一对一干预强度高、进步慢、家长压力大，长期处于高情绪劳动状态，流失率不低。
risks: 高强度情绪劳动，身心透支
进步缓慢，挫败感与自我怀疑
家长焦虑与期望压力
收入与付出不完全匹配
个案复杂，责任与专业风险并存

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能一分钟生成一份规范的计划，但那个在墙角尖叫、需要有人先陪他平复的孩子，要的是一个蹲下来的人——这是机器代替不了的陪伴，也是这个职业存在的理由。

responsibilities: 评估儿童发展并制定 IEP
开展一对一教学与干预
实施行为干预与康复配合

career_path_block.说明: Currently being replaced by CNC equipment

career_risk_cards.callout: The risk lies in knowing only manual material cutting. Nesting software and CNC cutting are replacing this work. Develop assembly precision, drawing interpretation, and equipment operation, and the robotics era will need you even more.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI, but prefabrication and digitization. BIM layout, CNC cutting, and robotic welding are reducing on-site manual fitting, and basic roles limited to reading drawings and cutting material are shrinking. Technicians who understand assembly precision and drawings remain scarce.
risks: Prefabrication and digitization reduce manual layout and cutting roles
Safety risks from work at height, lifting, and cutting
Noise, dust, and occupational health effects
Project cycles create workload fluctuations
Workers with narrow skills are readily replaced by equipment

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate optimal nesting plans and robots can produce straight welds, but skilled hands are still needed to align two imperfect steel beams securely on site and keep an entire building straight. Machines cannot yet replace this foundation of fabrication expertise.

responsibilities: Verify dimensions and deliver for welding

career_risk_cards.callout: 这行的风险在「只会手工下料」——套料软件和数控切割在替掉这部分活。往装配精度、读图和设备操作上走，机器人时代反而更缺你这样的人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「预制化与数字化」——BIM 放样、数控切割、机器人焊接正在减少现场手工修配量，只会看图下料的普工岗位在收缩，懂装配精度和图纸的技师依然紧俏。
risks: 预制化与数字化减少手工放样下料岗位
高空、吊装、切割作业的安全风险
噪音粉尘与职业健康影响
项目周期性，工作量波动
技能单一者易被设备替代

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算出最优套料方案，机器人能焊出笔直的焊缝，但把两根有偏差的钢梁在现场稳稳对上、让整栋楼站得正——这份手上功夫，是机器暂时替代不了的制造底气。
